documents.title: Chapman Considerations for Syllabus Policy on the Use of AI Generative Tools
documents.stance_why: The guide says Chapman will "allow individual instructors to determine their own syllabus statement" and that "Academic freedom allows you, the instructor, to select your own individual approach". It then offers sample statements at three permission levels (broad use, some circumstances, no use), so it sets no stance itself and delegates with tiers.
tiers: Use Permitted: Some Circumstances or With Explicit Permission
documents.summary: Provost taskforce guidance that leaves AI rules to individual instructors while adding a university-wide AI statement to minimum syllabus requirements, and supplies sample statements at three permission levels. It cautions against a blanket no-AI position and ties misuse to the Academic Integrity Committee.

documents.stance_why: The document is a general academic integrity procedure; it only says plagiarism includes the work of "an artificial intelligence" and that students must "adhere to instructor guidelines" including "use of artificial intelligence".
